holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by…
Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has…
